description: Bridge manifest: maps Figma component sets to q-nuxt-layer Vue components and their prop↔variant relationships. The agent reads this to sync either direction. See figma/README.md.

components.name: UxButton
components.note: Built to match code (Filled/Stroke), NOT legacy Flavor=Primary/Secondary/Danger. Danger lives in UxDangerDelete. Fills/strokes/text bound to Primitives variables (grape/400 3:8, grape/500 3:9, base/white 3:31, base/black 3:32).

disabled.note: State also has Hover (interaction state, no code prop)

components.name: UxToggle
components.note: Built On(On/Off) × Size(Small/Medium/Large); track grey/200 (off) / grape/500 (on), white knob with grey/300 border. Code has 5 sizes (micro/tiny/small/medium/large) — 3 representative built.

permaChecked.note: On = checked state (driven at runtime by the slotted input)

disabled.note: opacity / pointer-events only — not a variant

components.name: UxTag
components.note: grape/200 pill (warn → util/warn). × glyph white. Code text color inherits; used grape/700 as default.

components.name: SecuritySeverity
components.note: Dot + label per severity. Uses Tailwind default red/orange/yellow/grey, NOT brand tokens — bound critical→status/error, medium→status/warning, low→grey/400; high uses raw orange (no variable). Labels: crit!/high/medium/low.

components.name: DataStat
components.note: showHealth + isHealthy collapsed into a single Health variant (None/Healthy/Unhealthy). Label grey/400 with 4px bottom rule; value Inter Black. kind (percentage etc.) affects the value string at runtime, not a variant.

components.name: DataSparkChart
components.note: Static vector approximation of the chart.js line. Grape/500 stroke; Area fills grape/100. Real component is data-driven.

components.name: HealthDial
components.note: APPROXIMATION — 180° single-color gauge + needle per status. Source is a 270° multi-stop gradient SVG (cool/warn/warm/hot bands). For an exact match, import the SVG from components/health/Dial.vue instead of generating.
